source_data.known_limitation: SmolVLA flow-matching samples were not paired by physical-step-keyed noise; scores combine observation-conditioned revision and sampling variation

distance.normalization: per-dimension IQR fit once on development Fresh predicted arm actions only

label.physical_targets: u+2 through u+5 inclusive, where u=t+k
label.future_queries: u,u+1,u+2 only; no source before u
label.dispersion: median semantic distance from the three future predictions to consensus
label.aggregation_over_targets: median over the four local physical targets
label.invalidity: mask unless every target is inside the old chunk and every required future same-target prediction exists

control_relevance.outcome: DeltaY = Fresh success - intervention success; decisive target Z=indicator(DeltaY=+1)
control_relevance.alignment: For each active intervention step u with actual historical source age d, look up the Fresh-reference feature at source t=u-d and offset k=d. Never use treatment-trajectory predictions.
control_relevance.valid_step_rule: Use only logged source-event steps where the relevant component actual_source_age_steps equals d and the Fresh-reference feature is valid.
control_relevance.episode_condition_summary: arithmetic mean over valid active steps; age is d

uncertainty.episode_cluster: resample task-state clusters and retain their intervention rows
uncertainty.task_cluster: resample tasks and retain all decisive rows in each sampled task
uncertainty.paired_method_difference: compute PPPR minus RawPPR within each identical bootstrap resample

control_relevance.gate_guide: Held-out PPPR AUROC roughly at least 0.65; improve over RawPPR by roughly 0.05 or show similarly strong consistent rank separation; no catastrophic suite reversal
